# `openai_chat_completions_streaming_selector`

Selects the typed IRR response transport from an OpenAI Chat Completions request's effective `stream` bit.

## Configuration Notes

Place this inside every IRR step that may terminate an OpenAI Chat Completions request. It leaves the request body unchanged. Invalid or non-Chat JSON stays on the buffered transport so the selected upstream or a later validator retains ownership of the client-facing error.

## Example

```yaml
filter: openai_chat_completions_streaming_selector
```
